instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for a mobile web experience (viewport constraints, max width 480px if viewed on desktop, large touch targets >44px, hidden scrollbars).
Use 'Outfit' font for all headings, and 'Nunito' for body text. Make sure these are properly imported via Google Fonts.
The Home dashboard should prioritize the Month Grid. Do not overcomplicate the grid; use a simple minimal solid dot under days that have memory entries.
Implement the 'Day Detail Sheet' as a Bottom Drawer (using Vaul or Shadcn Drawer) that slides up from the bottom when a date on the calendar is tapped.
For the 'Add Memory' action, trigger a full-screen modal or another drawer with large, tactile inputs for media, voice note recording (emulated UI), and a text area for captions.
In the 'Play' tab, create distinct card styles for Daily Question, Daily Trivia, and Weekly Challenge. Use soft shadows and rounded-3xl borders to make them feel touchable and premium.
Ensure the weekly challenge card has a 'locked/blurred' state if viewed before Monday, or a clear 'Accept/Decline' interface.
All interactive elements must have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="btn-accept-challenge"`).
Do NOT use pure black/white for text and backgrounds. Stick strictly to the defined custom color palette. Everything must feel warm and inviting.
